title: Generated projects fail their own CI: biome ci, eslint (docusaurus.config.ts/sidebars.ts not in tsconfig), depcheck unused devDeps
description: Reproduced on origin/main 7505faf via NODE_ENV=development node smoke-test.mjs: in the scaffolded project, biome ci fails (package.json written by fse.writeJson expands arrays; organizeImports in tests/index.test.ts, docusaurus.config.ts, eslint.config.mjs; useNamingConvention in eslint.config.mjs), eslint . fails with parserOptions.project errors on docusaurus.config.ts and sidebars.ts, depcheck flags @vitest/coverage-v8, @commitlint/*, docusaurus-plugin-llms, docusaurus-plugin-typedoc, typedoc. The new pre-push hook (perf/faster-ci) runs the same checks, so a fresh project cannot push until this is fixed.

migrate: addSetupBun adds oven-sh/setup-bun to every pnpm job even when nothing in CI calls bun
description: src/workflows.ts addSetupBun inserts setup-bun before every pnpm/action-setup. Costs ~2.5s per job (measured in edgelite) when the job's scripts never call bun/bunx. Consider adding it only when the job text or the package.json scripts it runs reference bun. Template CI dropped setup-bun in perf/faster-ci; spinup-ts update would re-add it.
